title: evidence-binding/1
description: The input C02 validates before a concluded benchmark or hum-benchmark evidence record may count (GLOSSARY: Evidence record, Preregistration; ADR-0027): that record, the one subject (profile revision and host class) it speaks for, its typed preregistration and the membership of the set. It is a claim to be checked, never a proof: it carries no validated flag, and until C02 lands evidence.gates refuses concluded benchmark and hum-benchmark records and the status fold ignores them (C01).
